newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 30.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 30.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.86 (+0.48)

BHP announced long-awaited steel restructure on Tuesday, including the shutdown of Newcastle steelmaking and some other facilities. Analysts welcomed the plan which is expected to cut more than A$500 million in annual costs.

Seven announced the details on Tuesday of how MGM's US$573 million purchase of the Metromedia film library would be financed, including a plan to buy US$39 million of MGM stock and the confirmation of a plan to buy US$100 million of Tracinda Corp stock.

Kerry Packer is preparing to withdraw his company's offer to buy control of Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd to concentrate on a bid for newspaper publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd, the Australian newspaper said on Wednesday. The newspaper said PBL is expected to announce that it has decidied not to take up the option to buy Showboat's management rights and cite delays in the probity process making it difficult to meet some of the conditions of the deal.

Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd chief executive Don Mercer said on Wednesday that the high cost of major Australian banks prevented possible takeovers. "The cost of any of the major Australian banks is so high that I can't see who is going to want to make the acquisition," Mercer told Australian Broadcasting Corp Radio.
Gold miner St Barbara Mines Ltd said late on Tuesday that it has withdrawn its takeover offer for Mt Leyshon Gold Mines Ltd.
